applicabilityBasis.summary: This record is Synapse nexus USD (nUSD), the interchain liquidity unit in Synapse liquidity-pool bridging, rather than an unrelated Nexus-branded dollar token. Official documentation describes conversion of a source asset to nUSD, bridging that intermediary, then conversion to a destination native asset. The published function is protocol-internal liquidity settlement backed by an Ethereum pool; no issuance obligor promising holders a fixed amount of fiat or qualifying deposits is identified. It is not presented in the inspected sources as a standalone general-commerce payment instrument.

genius.notes: The GENIUS classification follows the documented internal bridge-liquidity role and lack of a documented fixed monetary-redemption obligation, not the base-file fiat-cash archetype or the status of the underlying pool assets. Stablecoin collateral and autonomous on-chain swaps do not themselves create issuer fiat redemption rights. No exact legal nUSD issuer is established, so issuerEntity and domicile are omitted. No derivative authorization from USDC, DAI or USDT is assigned. A materially different public payment/redemption arrangement would require reassessment.
